activity.notes: Sun Yat-sen assumed office as provisional president in Nanjing on 1 January 1912, tendered his resignation in February, and officially terminated his presidential duties on 1 April 1912. ATLAS uses a year-level 1912 term.

sources.title: Chronology of Dr. Sun Yat-sen — National Dr. Sun Yat-sen Memorial Hall
sources.citation_text: Official chronology records Sun's 1912 provisional presidency, 1917-1918 grand-marshal leadership of the Constitutional Protection government, 1921-1922 Guangzhou presidency, and restoration as grand marshal in 1923.

sources.title: Sun Yat-sen becomes first President of Republic of China — Oxford University Press
sources.citation_text: Oxford University Press describes Sun's election as provisional president in late 1911 and assumption of office in Nanjing on 1 January 1912.
